title: Case Study House No. 22 - National Register of Historic Places Registration Form (NRIS 13000519), with photographs and correspondence
contents: Final NRHP nomination as listed 2013-07-24 (Case Study House Program MPS). 28 pages: form pp.1-10, p.8 Google location map, p.11 LA County assessor's parcel map APN 5556-031-003 (1"=100'), pp.12-17 six colour photographs (2011), pp.18-28 NPS evaluation sheet, SHPO letter, OHP staff report on the MPS, LA Cultural Heritage Commission resolution. No architectural drawing of the house (no plan, section or elevation).
author: Amanda Seward, Los Angeles Conservancy Modern Committee
holder: National Park Service, National Register of Historic Places
license: US federal record; no licence statement on the asset page (page shows a 'Copyright' tab only)
evidence: guard check ALLOWED, guard get 200, 4,031,141 bytes (= File Size on asset page), PDF 1.6, 28 pages; contact sheet of all pages viewed; saved _work/guard/pages/npgallery.nps.gov/856f9afe_21b55ed9-5129-4f45-aef5-3067e3e9f11d (no .pdf extension)
notes: Only maps, no building drawings. Text p.3: L-shaped, ~2,300 sq ft, 20-ft modules, 12-inch I-beams, overhangs 7-8 ft, footbridge over pool. The second asset on the page (f7ce8ef5-..., 22,151 bytes) is a 1-page 'not yet digitized' placeholder.

title: Arts & Architecture, June 1960 (whole issue, USModernist AA-1960-06.pdf): 'Case Study House No. 22 by Pierre Koenig, architect', pp. 14-21; Merit Specified products p. 30
contents: Whole issue, 36 PDF pages = printed pages, OCR text layer. CSH 22 article pp. 14-21 (Shulman photographs, text on structure: 4in WF columns 20 ft apart, 12in WF beams, 20x20 ft bays, 5in steel roof deck spanning 20 ft and cantilevering 7 ft, concrete grade beams; 2,300 sq ft interior, 4,000 sq ft roof deck); drawing on p. 17 only (floor plan with site); p. 30 'Products merit specified for Case Study House No. 22' (text list); continuation of article on p. 31. Credits per OCR: William Porush engineer, Robert Brady contractor (OCR reading, not checked visually), interiors Van Keppel-Green.

title: Case Study House No. 22: floor plan with site (A&A June 1960, p. 17) - USModernist AA-1960-06
contents: Ground-floor plan of the built house on its pad: carport (C.P.) top left; bedroom wing along the top with children's room (two halves divided by a wardrobe partition, own bath) and master bedroom (M.B.); master bath, dressing (D.R.), utility (U) at the knee; living wing to the right with kitchen (K) island block, dining (D), living (L) with fireplace; pool (POOL) in the re-entrant angle with terrace (T); dashed roof outline and overhangs, column grid ticks; cliff edge line at left and bottom; north arrow and graphic scale bar 0-10 ft ('SCALE') below. Plan box spans about 2170x1920 px of the page scan.
author: Pierre Koenig, architect
holder: Arts & Architecture (The Travers Family Trusts); scan USModernist
license: USModernist terms: no unauthorized reproduction or distribution
evidence: page 17 plan region rendered at 1400 px and viewed; labels CHILDRENS RM, M.B., POOL, C.P., K, D, L read
notes: Preferred copy of this drawing (r1-0002 is the same plan in the artsandarchitecture.com excerpt at lower resolution).

title: Case Study House 22 (Stahl House) by Pierre F. Koenig, West Hollywood, construction completed 1960. Drawing, 1960. The Getty Research Institute
contents: Koenig's ink presentation perspective of the living-room end: eye point low, beyond the cantilevered floor edge, looking along the deep roof overhang with projecting steel roof beams into the all-glass living/dining space (furniture, a central planter or hearth element, dark tall element at the back), with the bedroom wing roof and hillside with palms at left; signed and copyright-marked at lower right (date not legible at this size); no scale. Matches the built scheme (flat roof, 20-ft bays, cantilever).
author: Pierre Koenig
holder: Getty Research Institute, Pierre Koenig papers and drawings 2006.M.30 (file name points to flatfile 22C, item 001; GRI image r31089)
